group.name: RB3 Bloom
group.description: Stage Kit rendering that reads each bank's density: lone LEDs punch bright with a glow, big fills bloom across the whole rig, and the plain mirror is always the fallback.

notes.label: Notes
notes.title: Density decides the treatment
notes.note: Every call counts how many LEDs each bank has lit and picks a treatment for that bank alone. One or two lit is 'sparse': the lights go to high brightness and their ring neighbours pick up a low glow. Six or more is 'dense': the bank also floods the whole rig in its colour. Three to five, and any bank that matches nothing, renders as plain Stage Kit, so the real LED positions and colours are always on show.

notes.label: Notes
notes.title: Always a fallback
notes.note: The lights are drawn unconditionally from the bank masks, exactly as the Stage Kit library does, and the density rules only add to them. If no rule matches, what is left is the faithful Stage Kit render rather than an empty rig.

notes.label: Notes
notes.title: Layers
notes.note: Black floor on layer 0, per-bank floods on layers 6-9, per-bank lights on the 10/20/30/40 bands plus the ring cell, and the neighbour glow on the 50/60/70/80 bands plus the ring cell. Everything blends with 'add', so overlapping banks composite the way the direct processor does and a dense bank saturates its lit cells.
